items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: he did a date once for Carly Simon

ctx.x: Would James Taylor ever go five flats to you?

No, no. I never got five flats. But you know what he loved is that he loved the capo. He liked to like tune the guitar down a whole step and still put the capo on and play like in the key that it would have been anyway without the capo. He had all these kinds of ideas about how the guitar resonated even if it was — you know so the capo meant a lot to him. He was like, “Don’t you want to use the capo?” I said, “I don’t have to.” I said, you know like Bucky used to say, he did a date once for Carly Simon. And he…
Did Bucky or John Pizzarelli ever use a capo on a date?
